children: Faron Pharmaceuticals Ltd | Company announcement | November 20, 2026 at 15:00:00 EET

TURKU, FINLAND – Faron Pharmaceuticals Ltd. (AIM: FARN, First North: FARON), a global, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on creating innovative cancer treatments that leverage the patient’s own immune system, today announces the following dates for the Company’s financial reporting in 2027:
Financial statement release for the full year 2026 and Annual Report 2026 including financial statements for the full year
Half-year financial report for the period January 1 to June 30, 2027
The Annual General Meeting is planned to be held on 30 March 2027. A separate stock exchange notice will be issued by Faron’s Board of Directors to convene the meeting.

is Faron’s proprietary, investigational immunotherapy designed to overcome resistance to existing treatments and optimize clinical outcomes by targeting myeloid cell function. It binds to Clever-1, a receptor on immunosuppressive macrophages that helps cancer evade the immune system. By targeting Clever-1,
reprograms the tumor microenvironment to ignite a potent anti-tumor immune response.

Faron (AIM: FARN, First North: FARON) is a global, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, focused on tackling cancers via novel immunotherapies. Its mission is to bring the promise of immunotherapy to a broader population by uncovering novel ways to control and harness the power of the immune system. The Company’s lead asset is
, a novel anti-Clever-1 humanized antibody, with the potential to remove immunosuppression of cancers through reprogramming myeloid cell function.

is being investigated in Phase 1/2 clinical trials as a potential therapy for patients with hematological cancers and solid tumors in combination with other standard treatments. Further information is available at www.faron.com.
